name: two-chassis
description: Builds on one-rack.plain: the same Premises and Rack (label "R1", height_u 42, ascending), plus two Device nodes, each with one Chassis (HasChassis). Each chassis is MountedIn the rack at a different position_u (10 and 20) with face set (front and rear -- both sampled, not a rule: MountedIn.face is optional and either value is legal). The first chassis owns 2 PhysicalPort nodes, the second owns 3, each attached via HasPort and carrying a label ("1", "2", ...), a position and a connector (rj45, sfp_plus, qsfp28 -- sampled from PhysicalPort.connector's closed vocabulary, not the only legal values). PhysicalPort.position is set on every port, but 19 section 3.3's PortPosition shape has no modelled fields yet (fathom-ir's own value::PortPosition stub), so on the wire it is the empty object {}; setting it records only that a position is known, not what it is. Every label, position_u, face and connector value here is a sample, never a fixed convention.
